sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुशनाभस्य धीमतः ।शिरोभिः चरणौ स्पृष्ट्वा कन्या शतम् अभाषत ॥१-३३-१॥
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ ।śirobhiḥ caraṇau spṛṣṭvā kanyā śatam abhāṣata ॥1-33-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of sagacious Kusanabha, his hundred daughters touched his feet with their heads and said:
translations.hindi: Ce रौ अ ~ ऊपतुमुंदितो वीरो प्रहष्टेनान्तरात्मना
